title: Dhurandhar In Depression | Stand Up Comedy Special Ft.Vaibhav Arora
description:
Dhurandhar In Depression | A Stand Up Comedy Special by Vaibhav Arora

Friends, I began my journey in professional stand up comedy around 10 years back. It has given me the most memorable moments of my life and it wouldn’t be wrong to say that most of my life has been spent in this aspiration of making it one day. Also, I wouldn’t say that my life would be incomplete without stand up, but probably I would like to say that I don’t have a life without it.

As any true journey that one undertakes to find meaning, love or passion, hardships are bound to test you and it so did test me.I did fight them with all my grit and valour and kept my ground when everything in life seemed to be falling apart be it relationships, friends or my ever changing jobs. But, what better way to share that experience than through stand up that did sustain me in all these challenges.

This video brings a glimpse of my journey of pursuing my passion and in a beautiful way would leave you touched, healed and comforted. 
I would be touring with my show ‘Mechanical Si Zindagi’ that would touch upon this story in a deeper way. I would love to have to come, witness it and be part of my journey.
See you all soon. 

PLEASE SHARE WITH AT LEAST ONE PERSON WHO IS ALSO DEALING WITH SOMETHING LIKE THIS AND MIGHT AS WELL PUT A SMILE ON THEIR FACE IF NOT MORE. 

Do share your own experiences in the comments below, would love to hear from you as well.

For show updates you can click on the link in the first comment.
